mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_operation_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR module LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR operation LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_operation_log (user_id, username, module, operation, method, request_url, request_params, response_result, ip, duration, status, error_msg, trace_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{module}, #{operation}, #{method}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestParams}, #{responseResult}, #{ip}, #{duration}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{traceId})
